<onlyinclude>This page forms a part of [[guskant|my]] resistance against the egocentrism of a Lojban community.
=A language derived from the official Lojban is considered as Lojban?=
On recognition of a language as Lojban, there is a customary double standard.

# Some languages derived from the official Lojban are currently advertized as "modern dialects of Lojban" <ref name="labangu">[https://mw.lojban.org/index.php?title=La_Bangu&oldid=116869#Conflicts_with_CLL_Lojban_that_break_past_usage La Bangu, 2015-08-13]</ref>, "Lojban" that includes "experimental" words <ref name="wave">[https://mw.lojban.org/index.php?title=Lojban_Wave_Lessons&oldid=117950 Lojban Wave Lessons, 2015-10-21]</ref><ref name="crash">[https://mw.lojban.org/index.php?title=The_Crash_Course_(a_draft)&oldid=106800 The Crash Course, 2014-08-24]</ref>, or even simply as "Lojban" <ref name="vivaldi">[https://vivaldi.net/en-US/teamblog/15-weekly-snapshot-1-0-129-2 Vivaldi browser snapshot 1.0.129.2] (Use of {la'oi}. Try command <tt>`LANGUAGE=jbo vivaldi`</tt>.)</ref>.
# Some languages <ref name="zantufa">[[zantufa|La zantufa]]: a series of parsers created by [[la guskant|me]].</ref><ref name="altatufa">[http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/mahantufa/altatufa.html La altatufa]: an unstable parser for experimental grammar created mainly by [[la gleki]].</ref> derived from the official Lojban are recognized as non-Lojban by some people <ref name="irc">On [https://kiwiirc.com/client/irc.freenode.net/?#jbosnu,#ckule,#lojban IRC Lojban channel], not necessarily publicly recorded.</ref>.

Someone doing 1 and 2 are identical persons, and that seems to [[guskant|me]] a sign of egocentrism: only the derivations agreed on IRC are permitted to be called Lojban; the other derivations constructed on values different from those of IRC users are excluded from Lojban. Calling la altatufa <ref name="altatufa" /> non-Lojban is not at all an objection to my view of the egocentrism. The reason for their recognition of la altatufa (or any other experimental parsers) as non-Lojban is that it is their own experiment of grammar, while their recognition of la zantufa <ref name="zantufa" /> as non-Lojban means exclusion from Lojban family of an unpleasant-to-them language that is actually used by [[guskant|a non-IRC person]].

The egocentrism may cause any future (or possibly past) lojbanists who would be satisfied with neither the official Lojban nor the IRC dialects to leave silently from a Lojban community (especially of IRC). [[guskant|I ]]am one of such lojbanists, but I'm sorry for doing it non-silently here because of my love for Lojban and my hate for the egocentrism of a community.</onlyinclude>

=Do you need an official standard for recognition of a language as Lojban, or keep the current situation?=

If you should decide on a standard, there are some incompatible alternatives.

# Only the official Lojban agreed by BPFK is called "Lojban", and
## any experimental gismu/cmavo, grammatical modifications don't form a part of Lojban;
## experimental gismu are recognized as a part of Lojban, and any grammatical modifications don't form a part of Lojban;
## experimental gismu and additions of experimental cmavo to the official grammar are recognized as a part of Lojban, and any other grammatical modifications don't form a part of Lojban.
# Any language derived from the official Lojban is called "Lojban",
## only with note of "unofficial", "experimental" or "dialect";
## with or without note of "unofficial", "experimental" or "dialect".
# Only the official Lojban and the derivations used on IRC are called "Lojban".
# Other.

Option 1 implies that many people including [[la gleki]] and [[guskant|me]] are culpable for calling derivation(s) of Lojban "Lojban".
It is acceptable to [[guskant|me]], but it means that a significant part of Lojban corpus is recognized as non-Lojban, not only the IRC-logs but also remarkable artworks {lo se manci te makfa pe la oz} <ref name="oz">''[http://selpahi.de/oz.html The Wonderful Wizard of Oz]'' by L. Frank Baum translated by [[la selpa'i]].</ref>, {ka catra lo verba} <ref name="kacatra">''[http://danmo-rozgu.github.io/kacatraloverba.html Att döda ett barn]'' by Stig Dagerman translated by la danmo rozgu.</ref> and so on. Moreover, it may prevent the growth of Lojban. 

Option 2 implies that some people including [[la gleki]], [[la durka|la durkavore]] and [[la tsani]] are culpable for asserting that la zantufa <ref name="zantufa" /> is not Lojban <ref name="irc" />.
It is reasonable option considering the current conditions of the official Lojban and actual use of derivations of Lojban.
Option 2.1 is [[guskant|my]] preference. If you choose 2.1, then [[la gleki]] should add a clear mentioning of "dialect" to the translation of Vivaldi browser <ref name="vivaldi" />, or remove {la'oi} from it.

Option 3 implies that only [[guskant|I ]]am culpable for asserting that la zantufa is one of Lojban parsers based on an unofficial grammar <ref name="zantufa" /> (or, possibly [[la xorxes]] is also culpable for la zasni gerna <ref name="zasni">[[zasni gerna|La zasni gerna]]: "This is a version (not official) of the full grammar of Lojban."  The dialects of IRC inherited only a part of it.</ref>).
[[guskant|I ]]don't support this option, but it is identical to the current customary standard that expelled me from Lojban community. Here is the proof <ref name="proof">Almost trivial, but written for those who guess wrongly the reason for the blame as their countless terms of abuse on la zantufa. I don't blame them for that. Their abuse on la zantufa is natural because it is constructed according to different values from theirs. I also wrote about dissatisfaction with la ilmentufa or la altatufa in [[zantufa|the introduction to la zantufa]] in a more polite way than their terms of abuse on la zantufa.</ref>:
<blockquote>Assume that Lojban community consists of Lojban speakers only &#91;S1&#93;. Suppose that a person ''P'' speaks neither the official Lojban nor the IRC derivations of Lojban, but a non-IRC derivation of Lojban. Option 3 implies that ''P'' does not speak Lojban &#91;S2&#93;. &#91;S1&#93; with &#91;S2&#93; implies that ''P'' is out of Lojban community. I am ''P''. Q.E.D.</blockquote>
